d: Indonesia is facing a massive political storm. President Prabowo Subianto is battling protests, public anger and a growing wildfire crisis. Now, a shocking wiretapping scandal has rocked his government. His former chief of staff and senior police officers are accused of illegally spying on the president, ministers, politicians and journalists. Did Prabowo's own men betray him? And how deep does this scandal go? Palki Sharma tells you.
